sentences.text: Ask 1. Stella Poon and Adrian Timpson host a podcast cast about health and fitness in Hong Kong.
They are now talking with a guest, Ricky Harrison, who is the founder of a charity called Sea Friends.
Listen to the interview and complete the information in the spaces below.
The first one has been provided as an example.
You now have 30 seconds to study the task.
At the end of the task, ask, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers.
Hello, everyone.
Today, we're continuing our mission to find out what people in Hong Kong are doing to become fitter and more active.
We sure are and we've got with us Ricky Harrison, the founder of Sea Friends, a charity which provides swimming lessons and organises swimming events here in Hong Kong.
Ricky, can you tell us about that?
When did you start Sea Friends?
Well, that was in the summer of 2015, so ten years ago.
Ten years already!
And how many people have learned to swim with you?
About 7,000 so far.
That's amazing.
How long does it take for someone to learn how to swim with you?
Well, with regular lessons, most people manage it in a few months.
I'd guess that most of our learners need about 20 hours.
Wow.
Only a few hours?
No, he said 20 hours.
That's a few months.
But, Ricky, who are these learner swimmers?
Who does Sea Friends help?
At the moment, most of our members are high school students.
Oh, and their parents.
We have a lot of parents taking part.
And when do the Sea Friends members meet?
We meet on Sundays because that's when the students tend to be free.
And the parents, of course.
Sure, the parents too.
Ricky, tell us a bit about yourself as a swimmer.
OK, well... I started swimming when I was four, with my older sister, and I remember getting my first award.
It was a purple badge, and I was so proud.
But when I was seven, I stopped swimming.
Oh?
Why was that?
Because of my swimming coach.
She was a good swimmer, but she was always shouting at me.
Hmm... that can't have been pleasant.
But you took up swimming again later.
Why did you decide to start swimming again?
Simple: I became a dad and I wanted to teach my own kids to swim.
Ah, swimming together as a family is great, isn't it?
It really is, but then I thought if I was going to be a teacher, I should get better at swimming myself so I looked for a new coach, and I found one.
He was an old school friend, actually.
What has Sea Friends got planned for the future, Ricky?
Anything on the horizon?
I'm glad you asked.
Next year we're starting the Grand Island Project.
We're all really excited about it.
And what's the Grand Island Project?
We're going to swim around every island in Hong Kong.
That must be 250 islands.
How are you going to manage that?
263 islands to be precise.
We're not doing all the islands at once, but we will eventually swim around every island in Hong Kong.
It's going to take a while, but it's a group effort and teams can choose which island they want to do.
Sounds "Grand" indeed.
Good luck with it.
Ricky, you told us before we recorded that Sea Friends is opening up for anyone to join.
So, why should our listeners join Sea Friends?
Well, it's free for one thing.
Members don't need to pay anything.
And there's nothing better than swimming.
Swimming is the best kind of exercise.
I tell this to everybody.
Another reason to join is you meet so many different people.
That's my favourite part: all the friends you make.
You heard it here first, listeners.
If you want to meet people and get the best kind of exercise, join Sea Friends.
Thanks for joining us, Ricky.
You're welcome.

questions.label: Q1
questions.prompt: The number of people who have learned to swim with Sea Friends: ___
questions.explanation: 这里问已学会游泳的人数。Ricky 说 About 7,000 so far，要把千位数字听准。

questions.label: Q2
questions.prompt: How long it takes to learn how to swim with Sea Friends: ___
questions.explanation: 评分参考接受 a few months 或 20 hours。Stella 误听成 a few hours，Adrian 随即纠正：No, he said 20 hours。要跟到纠正后的信息。

questions.label: Q3
questions.prompt: Who Sea Friends mainly helps: ___ and ___（填写两个群体）
answers: high school students and their parents
their parents and high school students
questions.explanation: 这题有两个空，要同时保留 high school students 和 their parents。只写学生或只写家长都少了一个信息点。

questions.label: Q4
questions.explanation: 录音直接说 We meet on Sundays。原句说明这是学生和家长较有空的时间。

questions.label: Q5
questions.prompt: Ricky first went swimming with his ___.
questions.explanation: 题目问第一次跟谁游泳，答案是 older sister。四岁、紫色徽章、七岁停止游泳是附近的信息，不是这个空所问的内容。

questions.label: Q6
questions.prompt: He stopped swimming because his coach ___.
questions.explanation: 原因是教练总对他大喊。Ricky 在录音里说 at me；填到题目的第三人称句子时要改成 at him 或 at Ricky。

questions.label: Q7
questions.prompt: He started swimming again because he wanted to ___.
answers: teach his own kids to swim
teach his own kids how to swim
teach his own children to swim
teach his own children how to swim
questions.explanation: 他说成为父亲后，想教自己的孩子游泳。题目已经有 wanted to，空内从 teach 开始；my own kids 改为 his own kids。

questions.label: Q8
questions.explanation: 要听新教练的身份。He was an old school friend, actually，指以前的同学；不是之前对他大喊的教练。

questions.label: Q9
questions.prompt: Next year's Sea Friends event — Name of event: ___
questions.explanation: 这里填活动名称 Grand Island Project。可以先记音，再用复听核对专名拼写。

questions.label: Q10
questions.prompt: Next year's Sea Friends event — Details of event: ___
answers: to swim around every island in Hong Kong
swim around every island in Hong Kong
swimming around every island in Hong Kong
questions.explanation: 要交代做什么和范围：swim around every island in Hong Kong。保留 around、every island 和 Hong Kong；只填岛屿数量或活动名称不够。

questions.label: Q11–13
questions.prompt: Three reasons why Ricky recommends joining Sea Friends — reason 1: ___
answers: members do not need to pay
members don't need to pay anything
members do not need to pay anything
swimming's the best kind of exercise
swimming is the best kind of exercise
there is nothing better than swimming
questions.explanation: 第 11–13 题可以任意顺序填写三个不同理由：免费；游泳是最好的运动；认识不同的人或交朋友。同一个理由重复填写只计一次。
